import random

# Define a list of magic ability categories
categories = ["Elemental", "Arcane", "Divine", "Nature", "Technomancy"]

# Define a list of magic ability ranks
ranks = ["Novice", "Apprentice", "Adept", "Master", "Legend"]

# Define a list of magic ability limitations
limitations = ["Physical exhaustion", "Magical backlash", "Unstable energy", "Dependence on specific materials", "Vulnerability to specific elements"]

# Define a list of magic ability costs
costs = ["Simple spellcasting", "Complex spellcasting", "Physical labor", "Magical research", "Divine intervention"]

# Define a list of magic ability descriptions
descriptions = [
    "The ability to manipulate the elements, summoning powerful storms or conjuring walls of flame.",
    "The ability to cast complex spells, weaving intricate patterns of magic to achieve a desired outcome.",
    "The ability to channel divine energy, healing wounds or imbuing allies with strength.",
    "The ability to communicate with nature, summoning animals or manipulating the growth of plants.",
    "The ability to harness the power of technology, creating complex machines or devices to achieve a desired outcome."
]

# Define a list of overpowered magic abilities
overpowered_abilities = [
    "The ability to manipulate reality itself, bending the fabric of space and time to achieve a desired outcome.",
    "The ability to summon and control powerful entities from other dimensions.",
    "The ability to absorb and redirect magical energy, making oneself nearly invulnerable to attack.",
    "The ability to create and control powerful magical constructs, such as golems or constructs.",
    "The ability to see into the future, predicting the actions of others and preparing accordingly."
]

# Define a function to generate a unique magic ability
def generate_ability():
    # Randomly select a category
    category = random.choice(categories)

    # Randomly select a rank
    rank = random.choice(ranks)

    # Randomly select a limitation
    limitation = random.choice(limitations)

    # Randomly select a cost
    cost = random.choice(costs)

    # Randomly select a description
    description = random.choice(descriptions)

    # If the ability is overpowered, select a unique overpowered ability
    if random.random() < 0.01:
        ability = random.choice(overpowered_abilities)
    else:
        ability = f"{category} {rank} {limitation} {cost}: {description}"

    return ability

# Generate 10 unique magic abilities
for _ in range(10):
    print(generate_ability())
